scene_contract: all 10 provided scenes, all 1158 transforms_train.json frames

teacher.query_free_regions: SAM3 multiscale hierarchy, full image plus 2 crop layers, all generated nonempty masks
teacher.native_region_encoding: masked RGB bbox plus 3 pixels; outside-mask gray127; resize384

map.geometry: surface Gaussian per nondegenerate provided mesh vertex; independent from semantic labels
map.write: pixel mixture of normalized overlapping region descriptors then normalized alpha-adjoint multiview sum
map.calibration: none; categorical argmax uses native cosine
map.descriptor_precision: serialize fp16 then renormalize before pixel mixing

query.readout: SigLIP native text cosine; separate 19/15/10 class argmax

evaluation.transfer: nearest Gaussian centre without distance cutoff
evaluation.mean: class mean per scene over present GT classes then scene macro
evaluation.input_fairness: unlabelled ground-truth mesh geometry is an additional input relative to RGB-only Gaussian reconstruction

legacy_comparator.identity: 96-coordinate four-teacher field, native512-code dictionary, scope composition, legacy source calibration; explicitly a different map recipe
